title: Mandacik Client
description: A lightweight Fabric client mod with customizable HUD and beautiful title screen!
body:
> **PLEASE SET BACKGROUND BLUR TO 0 IN "Video Settings" TO SEE HUD SETTINGS**

## Dependencies ❗
- 📝 Fabric: [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) (Required), [In-Game Account Switcher](https://modrinth.com/mod/in-game-account-switcher) (Required)

---

> **A lightweight Fabric client mod that adds a fully customizable HUD and a beautiful custom title screen!** 

---

## ✨ Features

### 📊 HUD (Heads-Up Display)
- ⚡ **FPS Counter** – always know your performance
- 📡 **Ping Display** – see your connection quality with color coding
- 🗺️ **Coordinates** – X, Y, Z always visible
- 🧭 **Direction** – know where you're heading
- 🌿 **Biome Display** – see your current biome
- 🕐 **Time Display** – in-game time with period (Morning/Afternoon/Evening/Night)
- ❤️ **Health Display** – color coded health bar
- 🛡️ **Armor Display** – current armor points
- 💨 **Speed Display** – real-time movement speed in blocks/second
- 💧 **Watermark** – stylish client watermark in top-right corner
- ⌨️ **KeyStrokes** – see your key presses in real time
- 🖱  **CPS Counter** - see your click presses in real time
- 🟩 **Block Overlay** - shows color at the block you looking at

### 🎨 Customization
- 🖼️ **6 HUD border colors** – Blue, Green, Red, Yellow, Pink, White
- 🖼️ **6 Block Overlay colors** – Blue, Green, Red, Yellow, Pink, White
- 🔧 **Toggle every HUD element** individually
- 💾 **Config auto-saves** – your settings are always remembered

### 🌍 Languages
- 🇵🇱 **Polish** language support
- 🇬🇧 **English** language support
- 🔄 Switch language anytime in settings

### 🎬 Title Screen
- ⭐ **Animated star field** with parallax effect
- 🌌 **Nebula effects** that react to your HUD color
- 🌠 **Aurora animations**
- ✨ **Shooting stars**
- 🎯 **Custom buttons** – Singleplayer, Multiplayer, Mod Library, Options, Quit

### 📦 Mod Library
- 📋 **List of all installed mods**
- 🔍 **Mod name, version and ID**
- 🖱️ **Smooth scrolling** with mouse wheel

---
